summary: Merchant receipts and their line items as evidence of a sale.

targets.utterance: File this grocery receipt. The total was 18.40 USD.
targets.distinguish: Keep the merchant and currency as supplied. A receipt alone does not establish a particular posted account transaction.

targets.utterance: This line on my grocery receipt is 2.75 USD for apples.
targets.distinguish: Select the source receipt. Do not turn its items into a new shopping list.
